notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/11457eb25137af06de2ed55da314c8e9476677a6.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that [i][b]Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror[/b][/i], the newest installment in the Dollhouse series, will officially launch on[b] Steam[/b] on [b]March 28, 2025[/b]! Prepare to join Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish realities and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

Thanks,
-SOEDESCO

[h2]Wishlist NOW[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/

notes.title: v1.0 launch day!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today is the day. Dog Duty was launched out of Early Access and v1.0 is now live! I want to thank you all for the support and trust you've given us during the Early Access period of Dog Duty. A lot has happened, and it is all thanks to your feedback! Thousands of bugs have been squashed, new enemies and vehicles were added and even a whole new game mode was implemented into the game! Now of course, this v1.0 comes with some patch notes, so here they are!

[list]
[*]Added a brand new Horde mode map
[*]Completed Horde Mode screens
[*]Tweaks on horde calculations and challenge
[*]Fixed issue that could halt boss wave on Horde Mode
[*]Fixed collisions/map of Swamp's Armor Supply
[*]Improvements on gamepad's target snapping
[*]Added a very specific and secret character on Horde mode, that may be unlocked by doing something very specific ;)
[/list]

I hope you'll all have fun with Dog Duty, and of course if there's any feedback you might still have, please let us know!

-Marten

notes.title: Brand new game mode implemented - Horde Mode
notes.content:
Hi all!

Today we have great news, as an all new game mode was just added to Dog Duty: Horde Mode! Battle waves of enemies with your squad and survive! You can find the new game mode by clicking 'play' in the main menu and clicking the button on the bottom! 

As this is a very early implementation of Horde Mode, we're very eager for your feedback! Please let us know what you think and what could be improved on the Steam Community Hub. We're planning to iterate this mode very regularly, so stay tuned for updates!

This patch also contains some other fixes, so here are the full patch notes for v0.992
[list]
[*]Added a beta version of a Horde Mode. Battle waves of enemies and survive in this brand new game mode! We're eager to hear feedback and ideas on this!
[*]Heroes now have a brief recover animation, and will take a little more time to get up
[*]Fixed issue that showed turret ranges after leaving Vehicle-Setup
[*]Fixed a physics issue that could block the hovercraft on a specific spot near Swamp's POW Camp
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the hovercraft from being a target on specific situations
[*]Fixed some specific blocking situations involving the map, vehicle icons etc.
[*]Now the pause screen and general menus do not overlap while using a game pad
[/list]

Now jump into the game and survive Horde Mode, soldier! And again, please let us know what you think ;)

-Marten

There is now more variation in enemies you'll encounter in each region of the game, which spices things up quite a bit! Check out the full patch notes here:
[list]
[*]Added a LOT of new soundtrack from Bettina Calmon!
[*]New enemies (six in total) with different kinds of weapons. From machete soldiers to ballistic shield troops, they will challenge our heroes' pragmatic skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/48267e7d7da1ca40dcd0506a24a73af6be978e1e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/8c5d3eaa66345e3b32435ac5371c401ace98fe65.gif[/img]

[*]Fixed bug that prevented player vehicles from getting repairs on friendly locations
[*]Added markers showing each hero/enemy weapon radius, that shows on the "Reality-Check Mode".
[*]Fixed enemy odd behaviour on a specific Capital level.
[*]Fixed parking area display on Desert Pow Camp
[*]Removed odd tip on a particular Capital level
[*]Fixed issue when player soldiers try to collect pickups during vehicular combat
[*]Fixed and issue where reinforcement warning wouldn't dissapear
[*]Fixed flag change cutscene on Swamp Boss location
[*]Fixed odd behaviour of enemy stuck far away from player's Hovercraft
[/list]
I hope you all like it! We're still very much looking for feedback, and I'd really appreciate if you guys could let me know what still can be improved on the game, especially now in terms of game balance.

Have a great day!

-Marten

notes.title: Dog Duty patch notes - v0.94
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today I have some GREAT NEWS, because we have a big update live right now! v0.94 is now available for all of you to play, and there's some juicy stuff in there. Let's dive into it with the patch notes!

[b]Reinforcement System Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new specific soldier model to act as reinforcement, so it will be clearer which soldier is a reinforcement and which one isn't
[*]The reinforcement vehicles are also new, and characterized as police vehicles. (New boats for swamp/river, new car for desert)
[*]There's also been some minor tweaks like timing and other details
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/db33898288eeb2795cc78c289f71d0e8c4defb4c.gif[/img]

[b]Other new stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new troop transport vehicle, that carries up to 8 soldiers, with the additional of a shooter on the roof or a parabomb launcher
[*]The new Octo-Light-Tank, will be participating on some patrols in the Desert.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/336e9406383153efc90be90122f008a5304e132d.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Lots of improvements on general game performance
[*]Some tweaks and changes on the UI/HUD: for example, the inventory icon now is a backpack, among other changes
[*]WASD now may be used to control vehicles on World-Mode
[*]Corrections on the intro conversation at the Octopia gates
[*]There's now a new "Radio-System", to help entering and exiting locations
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/001e40a0f5e329ba12799690d7eb6d051352c827.gif[/img]
[List]
[*]Chat baloons now show more lines, helping the readability of bigger text
[*]There's now NPCs when you conquer a location. They may tell useful information... or not
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/db2b0dcb546a0d7e694640e8937318cdd4e5ff09.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Added new loading screen to.. well, show when things are loading, of course!
[*]The endgame animation was remade
[/list]

[b]General bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would disappear when getting back to main menu
[*]Fixed a bug where landmines would explode infinitely
[*]Fixed a bug where some buttons would not show up properly in specific cases
[*]Fixed a bug where the intro location was not showing as conquered location
[*]Fixed details like opening a new game file after deleting a file and selecting a new item to buy after buying an item
[*]Fixed an issue with scrolling through available mounted weapons in the vehicle's menu with controller
[/list]

That's it for this patch, but I hope you all enjoy it because there's quite some new stuff in there! As you might've heard already, we also announced that Dog Duty is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One this spring! Check out that announcement here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/578690/announcements/detail/1694979421812991362
Okay bye!

-Marten

notes.title: Dog Duty Patch notes v0.918
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a while since we posted on here, but that doesn't mean we've been lazy! There's been two patches done before this one, so I'll add those notes in here as well. Here's the full overview!
[list]
[*]Fixed some issues that led to stuck soldiers on the battlefield
[*]Revision on some gameplay logic
[*]Gameplay fixes on swamp levels
[*]Fixed issue that prevented players from entering the Swamp Island
[*]Added more content to  Swamp, Capital and Desert islands
[*]Updates to make the world more lively such as toucans flying around in the swamp and more trees and buildings in swamp environments. There's also more buildings, cars, silos, trees, and potato crops on the desert island. On the river island, there's also more buildings and watchtowers added
[*]Addressed bug regarding making a bad savegame on the final base
[*]Added soldier dialog in several locations
[/list]
For the next update, we're working on solving performance issues, bug solving and adding content that we think will improve the game for the best: a proper Octopia Capital final stage!

This new Octopia Capital will feature a new checkpoint location, a driveable field with a final car battle, and a re-worked Octopia Garden, the final location itself.

That's what we have for now but we'll be back soon with more updates!

-Marten

notes.title: What now?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/01bd65fc283af53c1233540da49ea7fd56d4c19c.jpg[/img]

On the end of June, Dog Duty were on Big Festival, and we watched-and-updated the game during the 4 event days straight. It was really great to watch the players interact with the game. Now, it's time to do the final plans for the release.

There's some small content additions (Bettina is working on the Boss music, and I'm planning a new addition to the travel hud), but, the major work from here, will be:
[list]
    [*]Porting, to the Xbox One and PS4. The process will change the pc version too, as there will be more testing, strict regulations and all.
    [*]Bug fixing, they will take the best of my time, but, well, it will be great to finally solve some issues.
[/list]

There's more to be said, but I will save it for the next updates. The new music tracks are almost ready, and I hope that the new hud will be too.

Until then!

notes.title: The Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/2f2172754a10794548f63996950b45b810b78724.gif[/img]
In 4 years of development, Dog Duty evolved from a simple base-defense game to a simplified-open-world-guerrilla-simulator. To reinforce the current game, the Soundtrack Update is on.

There's also some things to note:

-There's a new bug report tool. Located on the MainMenu, It sends your game files to us. It's great for reporting issues with save files, and believe me, save files with issues are gold here.

-Achievements to the game! We're still testing... but they should be 100% sure working in a week of testing.

-We're working hard to finish game on July, on the max. The Final Boss is coded and fully functional, but, it's temporarily disabled, until I work on the game finishing.

There's also a lot of bug fixes and other additions.
As always, please share your opinions, thoughts and bug reports on the forums! Thank you all very, very much, on supporting Dog Duty!

notes.title: The voice update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/9af85de37024e262742ff922affec710c60019f7.jpg[/img]
There's a new update, with a lot of fixes and additions, but the most noticeable update will be on the audio.

Now Kilmer and Paula character features it's own voices. The radio effect also got some work, and we would love to hear what you guys think.

There's a test-purpose-option to enable the original audio voices, among other little things.

There's one thing that dont got into the update: the Capital, and it's Final Battle. It's taking a little longer than expected to finish, but we're taking care to script everything right (the game ending as well).

The next update, of course, will be the Capital Update, and we hope to have it done as soon as possible.

notes.title: The Mount Octopus Update

- finishing Paula's character (the voice acting part, mostly)
- finishing touches on the river's main weapon, the Tesla Pack
- some water effects

And I think that's it. I'm dying to finish all and get back to bugs and testing.
(PS: yep, it's the same Desert Boss. I'm scheduling the unique Swamp and River bosses for a future development phase).

notes.title: Week 7 - The Swamp world taking shape
notes.content:
We've sketched and developed the entire swamp world space (with stub locations). Different from the desert, the swamp is a different kind of hell.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/78da55ac5c3d83e2e4ad1a1f6e8f6fe28400eaed.gif[/img]

With non-stop rain and a lot of mud, the player will use a hovercraft to navigate on this area (you may keep driving the truck if you want, but it will be a little... challenging in some ways).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/b7557dab54f703e6b8f95dc8169a5b238fa50692.gif[/img]

We're rushing to finish a playable state of this world as soon as possible. But it will only happen when we get the following items fully working:

- all playable locations
- the new ally to rescue (it's already done)
- enemy water vehicles (we're halfway on this)
- fine tuning on the player's hovercraft
- the boss (but we're still thinking if we may upload the swamp without it).

These are our weekly tasks.
As always, we're eager to hear from you guys. See ya!
